title: December, 2016
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Does Chloe come home. A printed card. Chloe & Julian, a dog of their own, a doodle. She's drawn on the card in pen: 'not coming. sorry. the dog is named after nothing.'

panels.composition: The garage. A glossy card. WOOD. BARNABY II trying to eat the envelope.

image.prompt: a man holding a glossy printed holiday card in a garage while a three-legged dog chews the envelope, clean ink

panels.composition: The card: Chloe, Julian, and a small clean dog with a bandana. Printed: HAPPY HOLIDAYS. Across it in her pen: 'not coming. sorry. the dog is named after nothing. — c.'
props: printed card with handwriting over it

image.prompt: a glossy holiday card photo of a woman, a pleasant man and a small clean dog in a bandana, with handwriting scrawled across it in pen
image.notes: Letter after: not coming. sorry. the dog is named after nothing. — c.

balloons.text: Named after nothing. She's telling me his isn't named after mine. She's telling me that on purpose.

image.prompt: a man speaking to a three-legged dog while looking at a card, wry and hurt at once

panels.composition: The corkboard. The card, photo-in again. Beside it the 2011 one, photo-in. Two cards facing the wall. The pup has the envelope.

image.prompt: a crowded corkboard where a man pins a holiday card face-in beside another pinned the same way, a dog with a torn envelope beneath, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: 'Named after nothing.' Two cards facing the wall.
